title: Utah v. Strieff (2016)
key_points: Holding: Discovering a valid, pre-existing arrest warrant during an unlawful stop can attenuate the connection to evidence found in a search incident to arrest.
officer_notes: Scenario: After an unjustified stop, you discover a warrant, arrest the man and find drugs.
Takeaway: Don't rely on this; make lawful stops. NJ applies its own attenuation analysis.
